values.note: 34 tent/RV sites in two camping areas (13 take an RV, the rest are tent-only), plus 25 lean-tos. Four RV sites list more than 20 ft: 7 and 9 (30 ft, area A) and 35 and 42 (25 ft, area B); the other nine list 20 ft.

note: Remote CCC-era park at the south end of Maidstone Lake in the Northeast Kingdom, about 5 miles of State Forest Highway from Route 102. Camping area A's prime sites 2-8 sit between the shore road and the lake, looking at the water through a fringe of trees; site 7 (30 ft) is the one there that takes a 23-ft rig. Campers can rent canoes, kayaks and a rowboat; there is no boat launch. --Claude
